#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using vi = vector<int>; using vvi = vector<vi>;
using ii = pair<int,int>; using vii = vector<ii>;
using l = long long; using vl = vector<l>; using vvl = vector<vl>;
using ll = pair<l,l>; using vll = vector<ll>; using vvll = vector<vll>;
using lu = unsigned long long;
using vb = vector<bool>; using vvb = vector<vb>;
using vd = vector<double>; using vvd = vector<vd>;
const int INF = numeric_limits<int>::max();
const double EPS = 1e-10;
const l e5 = 100000, e6 = 1000000, e7 = 10000000, e9 = 1000000000;

l modular_exponentiation(l base, l exponent, l modulus) {
  l result = 1;
  while (exponent > 0) {
    if (exponent & 1) result = (result * base) % modulus;
    base = (base * base) % modulus;
    exponent >>= 1;
  }
  return result;
}

const l MODULUS = e9 + 7;

int main() {
  ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
  cin.tie(nullptr);
  l p, k;
  while (cin >> p >> k) {
    if (k == 0) {
      cout << modular_exponentiation(p, p - 1, MODULUS) << "\n";
      continue;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
      cout << modular_exponentiation(p, p, MODULUS) << "\n";
      continue;
    }
    vector<bool> visited(p, false);
    l cycle_count = 0;
    for (l i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
      if (visited[i]) continue;
      l j = i;
      l length = 0;
      while (!visited[j]) {
        visited[j] = true;
        j = (j * k) % p;
        length++;
      }
      if (modular_exponentiation(k, length, p) == 1) cycle_count++;
    }
    cout << modular_exponentiation(p, cycle_count, MODULUS) << "\n";
  }
}
